title: feat(models): show context window and video duration limits in catalog
author: TRDEFI
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #13905

Shows model limits without adding more visible badges:

- Preserves `context_length`, `min_duration`, `max_duration`, and `allowed_durations` from the catalog.
- Adds the available context window and video duration to the existing model-details tooltip.
- Reuses the same tooltip on desktop and mobile.

Only declared limits are shown; `default_duration` is not treated as a limit.

gist.headline: Limits, now less mysterious
gist.blurb: The model catalog now keeps the useful fine print where it belongs: right beside the model. Hover or tap to see how much context or video time the little machine can actually hold.
gist.summary: The model catalog now preserves declared context_length, min_duration, max_duration, and allowed_durations fields and shows context-window and video-duration limits in the existing model-details tooltip on both desktop and mobile.
gist.impact: People choosing chat or video models can now check each model's available context window and declared video durations without extra catalog badges or guessing from a default duration.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a curious CRT monitor robot inspect a cozy seed-catalog shelf of AI models, with a magnifying-glass tooltip revealing a scroll-like context window and a tiny hourglass/video reel marked with duration choices. The scene represents limits as useful labels on seed packets rather than warnings, with code-plants and flowers making the catalog feel like a garden reference desk.
